title: feat(console): configure tabs on installed objects, into the paired .custom package (#36499, PR 2 of 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Wq5utqEodnDCBh6heq37AG)_
Fixes #36499

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员在已安装（只读）应用的记录页「…」第一项就能「配置页签」，可拖动全部页签、隐藏或恢复关联页签，每个页签标明来自原包、其他包还是本环境；保存后所有人看到新排列，原包不动。自建应用的入口也挪到「…」第一项。
- 为什么做：本卡「记录页就地配置页签」的第二个也是最后一个合并请求，替管理员省去进 Studio 改已安装对象的绕路。
- 出错会怎样：只影响已安装对象记录页的页签排列，写在该应用配对的定制包里；管理员可再次进入配置改回，原包始终不变。定制总览读接口暂不列出页签排列，已另开卡跟进（定制总览列出页签排列）。
- 要你做什么：无（是否允许在已安装对象上隐藏附件、审批、动态三个内置页签，已另开决策卡等你裁定）。

## What changes

**Installed objects (card items 4 and 7).** On the record page of an object whose package is installed read-only, 「Configure tabs」 is now offered too. The gate is PR 1's admin gate (Studio opens the object, posture `view` here) plus `useCustomizeDoorWalled()`: where the customization door is walled (`group` / `isolated`), the entry is not offered. The edit state is the same one PR 1 built: the design-mode shell from #36437, reused unchanged.

- Every tab can be moved: the object's own lists, a list another package brings, and the built-in 附件 / 审批 / 动态.
- A related tab can be hidden and shown again. A built-in tab cannot be hidden here, because the `.custom` list cannot hide it (spec: "cannot be hidden here"). An attachments tab the base does not draw waits in 「Hidden」 and can be shown from there.
- Each related tab carries a source mark: 「Original package」, 「From PACKAGE」 or 「This environment」.
- 「Save」 writes the `relatedLists` of the pair's object extension (`object_extension`, filed under the object's name, in the base's paired `.custom` package), in #36498's shape. The write lists every shown tab in order (a built-in by its bare name) and then every hidden related tab as `{ list, hidden: true }`. A tab the list does not name is served after the named ones.
- The pair is resolved through the ensure door (`POST /packages/:id/ensure-customization`). That door creates the pair on the first save, as Studio does. A pair the server does not list as writable is refused before any write.

**One shared writer.** `views/objectExtensionArrangementSave.ts`, `saveObjectExtensionArrangement`, is the only write of an installed object's arrangement keys (`CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS`).

- It reads the pair's STORED extension and the object as stored (the layered read).
- It replaces only the keys its caller returns. Every other key is kept: `fields`, `fieldPatches`, `place`, the other arrangement key.
- It saves a draft with the first-write pin (`ifNoneMatch: '*'`), then publishes. A refused publish discards that draft.
- It announces the refresh through the door.

The field-layout editor in #36505 is meant to be its second caller (`fieldGroups`). #36505 is not implemented here. `resolveRecordTabsSaveTarget` now answers `{ kind: 'package' } | { kind: 'pair' }`.

**The 「…」 entry is the first item (card item 1).** `page:header` (`containers.tsx`): a host overflow entry that declares `leadsMenu: true` is drawn first, ahead of Refresh, with a separator. Only host entries can claim this place; an authored action cannot. The record page's 「Configure tabs」 declares it, on self-built and installed objects alike. No other entry declares it, so no other menu changes.

**A stored title is kept (fix to PR 1's write).** Since #36574, the served `relatedLists` labels are translated for the reader. PR 1 wrote the editor's labels back as they were, which would have stored a reader's translation as the title. Now a tab's stored label is written unless the administrator renamed it (`recordTabLabelToWrite`). This holds on both paths.

**i18n.** New keys under `designMode.recordTabs`: `pairNotWritable`, `builtinMoves`, `sourceBase`, `sourcePackage`, `sourceEnvironment`. They are added to all eleven locales; zh-Hant is regenerated by `gen-zh-hant`.

- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-overflow-close-36499.test.tsx`:

  - a new describe has 2 cases for `leadsMenu`.

Ablations. The fix was committed first. Each mutation was written with `ablation-replace.mjs`, and each restore was proven by blob == HEAD.
- Dropping the `leadsMenu` flag: 1 test red.
- `recordTabLabelToWrite` returning the served label: 2 tests red.

## Acceptance notes

- **The customizations read does not list an arrangement: moved to #36626** (seat routing, 2026-11-23 04:26Z). After the save, `GET /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/customizations` answered `200` with every list empty. The extension itself is there: `GET /api/v1/meta/object_extension/showcase_account?package=com.example.showcase.custom` answers it. The read's contract is strict and names exactly three member kinds, `extensions.kind` = `field` | `validation` | `index`, so a `relatedLists`-only extension (and a `fieldGroups`-only one, for #36505) has no entry to appear as. Making it appear is a spec and runtime change, carried by #36626, not by this PR.
- **H2 (a per-tab source on `_relatedListsArrangement`) does not hold; the narrow gap below is an accepted deviation** (seat routing, 2026-11-23 04:26Z; no card). The decoration carries `{ packageId, hidden, unlisted }` and nothing per tab. The source marks are derived from data the client already has:
  - the child object's `_packageId`: the base means the original package; `sys_metadata` or a `.custom` package means this environment; anything else means that package;
  - a relationship field named `__c` means this environment.

  The remaining gap: a relationship field that another package's extension adds to a base-owned child object shows as 「Original package」. Closing it needs a per-tab source from the server. No spec or server change is made here.
- **Built-in tabs stay locked here: hiding them goes to decision card #36627** (seat routing, 2026-11-23 04:26Z). On installed objects 附件 / 审批 / 动态 can be moved but not hidden: the spec says the `.custom` list cannot hide them ("cannot be hidden here"). They are not renamable either, on either path: a built-in entry is a bare name in the spec's shape and carries no label, so there is no place to store a rename. Seat ruling 7089839334 (no spec card for hiding 审批/动态 on self-built objects) is unchanged.
- **Translated labels.** PR 1 combined with #36574 would have written a reader's translated tab title into the stored definition on any save. Fixed on both paths; see What changes.
- **Visible effect beyond the card.** 「Configure tabs」 now sits above Refresh in every record 「…」 where it is offered, including on self-built objects (PR 1 placed it after Refresh). No other menu entry moves.
- **Observation, not filed.** For an installed object, the layered read's `code` layer (`GET /meta/object/showcase_account/layers?package=com.example.showcase`) answered the extension-folded `relatedLists`, while the showcase source declares none. The writer reads entries in the order extension first, then owner, so this does not change what is written. I note it because a reader of `code` would take the result for the package's own definition.
- **CI patch round 1 (head 28193dbe9).** At c7f9b5859, `Test UI (13/16)` went red on one test that this change does not touch: `DataPillar.panelHold-27629` › "Show me" reopens the action…, a 3000 ms `waitFor` on the held line. That test was last changed by #36597 on main. No file in its import graph is in this diff, and the dom project runs `isolate: true`, so no other file's mocks reach it. Under os-verify-lock it passed alone (5/5) and with all 41 `DataPillar.*` files on 4 workers (209/209). The merge group's CI for #36597 and the later runs on main are green. I read it as a timing flake in a loaded shard (that file took 10 s there), not a defect of this change, so no code or test was changed for it. The new head is a merge of main (3110de5a0), which re-runs CI.
- **H1 holds.** The extension is written as `object_extension` in the pair, and only `relatedLists` is replaced (unit: `objectExtensionArrangementSave-36499` keeps `fields`, `fieldPatches`, `place` and `fieldGroups`). Live: the second save in the browser pass read back the first save's extension and replaced only its list.

## Verification

Browser pass at head `0aacc5aad`, with the same code as this head; the merge of main brought in no file this change reads.

- Booted example app: `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`, own port and DB). The console was rebuilt from this branch.
- Installed read-only package: `com.example.showcase` (type app, `writable: false`).
- Object: `showcase_account`, record Northwind.
- Before the first save: no `com.example.showcase.custom` package existed, and the customizations read was empty.
- To show a tab from another package, the run's DB holds a QA package `com.qa.tabs` with an object `qtab_visit` that looks up `showcase_account`. It exists only in the run's DB.

<details><summary>Admin, 1440: reorder, hide, save, reload</summary>

- 「…」 read `Configure tabs, Refresh, Share, Change Owner, Delete`.
- Editor chips:
  - `showcase_contact` [Original package]
  - `showcase_field_zoo.f_lookup` [Original package]
  - `showcase_field_zoo.f_lookups` [Original package]
  - `qtab_visit` [From Tabs QA]
  - 审批
  - 动态
- I dragged Visits first, hid 「Field Zoo · Lookup → Accounts (multiple)」 and saved. The writes, in order:
  - `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization`
  - `PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/showcase_account?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom`
  - `POST /api/v1/meta/object_extension/showcase_account/publish?package=com.example.showcase.custom`
- Nothing was written to `com.example.showcase`.
- Tabs after save and after a reload: `Details, Visits, Contacts, Field Zoo, Activity`.
- The pair's extension then read `{"extend":"showcase_account","relatedLists":["qtab_visit","showcase_contact","showcase_field_zoo.f_lookup","sys_approval_request","sys_activity",{"list":"showcase_field_zoo.f_lookups","hidden":true}]}`.
- The served object carries `_relatedListsArrangement: {"packageId":"com.example.showcase.custom","hidden":["showcase_field_zoo.f_lookups"],"unlisted":"shown"}`.
</details>

<details><summary>Original package unchanged</summary>

- `GET /meta/object/showcase_account/layers?package=com.example.showcase` answers `overlay: null`, `draft: null`, `provenance: package`, `editable: false`.
- `GET /meta/object_extension?package=com.example.showcase` answers `items: []`.
- `git status examples/` is clean.
- The customizations read: see Acceptance notes.
</details>

<details><summary>Another account (plain member), 1440 and 1280</summary>

- 「…」 read `Refresh, Share`: no entry.
- The member's served object carries the same `relatedLists` and the same `_relatedListsArrangement`.
- Tabs drawn: `Details, Field Zoo, Activity`. The multi-lookup tab is hidden. Visits and Contacts are not drawn because the member has no read on `qtab_visit` and `showcase_contact` (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED` on the data read), as before this change.
</details>

<details><summary>Admin, 1280: second save over the existing extension</summary>

- The menu's first item is 「Configure tabs」.
- On reopening, the editor shows the saved order and 「Field Zoo · Lookup → Accounts (multiple)」 in 「Hidden」.
- I moved 动态 ahead of 审批, showed the hidden tab again and saved. The same three writes followed (ensure, pinned draft, publish).
- After a reload: `Details, Visits, Contacts, Field Zoo · Lookup → Account, Field Zoo · Lookup → Accounts (multiple), Activity`.
- A separate drag (not saved) moved 动态 to the very front, so built-ins move to any place.
</details>

<details><summary>Self-built path (PR 1), admin, 1280</summary>

- On `qtab_account` (package `com.qa.tabs`, writable), 「…」 read `Configure tabs, Refresh, …`.
- Chips carry no source mark.
- I dragged People first and saved. The writes were `PUT /meta/object/qtab_account?mode=draft&package=com.qa.tabs`, then `POST …/publish?package=com.qa.tabs`.
- After a reload: `People, Deals, Tickets, Attachments, Activity`.
</details>

The 「This environment」 mark is covered by `RecordTabsConfigInstalled-36499` and `recordTabsInstalled-36499`. It was not set up in the browser.

Screenshots (`/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/shots/36499-pr2/`):
- `01-admin-1440-menu-first-item.png`: 「Configure tabs」 first in 「…」 on the installed object
- `02-admin-1440-installed-edit-state.png`: the edit state with source marks
- `03-admin-1440-installed-moved-hidden.png`: Visits moved first, multi-lookup tab in 「Hidden」
- `04-admin-1440-installed-after-reload.png`: after save and reload
- `05-member-1440-installed-menu-no-entry.png`, `05-member-1280-installed-menu-no-entry.png`: the member's 「…」 and tabs
- `06-admin-1280-menu-first-item.png`: the entry first at 1280
- `07-admin-1280-installed-reopened.png`: reopened on the saved arrangement
- `08-admin-1280-installed-moved-restored.png`: 动态 moved, hidden tab shown again
- `09-admin-1280-installed-after-reload.png`: after the second save and reload
- `10-admin-1280-selfbuilt-edit.png`, `11-admin-1280-selfbuilt-after-reload.png`: the self-built path

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectExtensionArrangementSave.ts`: which keys are kept and which are replaced, the pinned draft, publish, and the discard on a refused publish.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordTabsInstalled.ts`, `installedTabsEntries`: what the pair's list holds (built-ins bare, hidden related tabs, kept unknown entries, stored labels).
3. `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`: `leadsMenu`, in the record bar and in the state-group menu.

Two-minute check: in `examples/app-showcase`, run `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`. As admin, open any Account record and open 「…」. The first item is 「Configure tabs」. Hide a tab, drag another, and save. `GET /api/v1/meta/object_extension/showcase_account?package=com.example.showcase.custom` answers the new `relatedLists`.
